summary: Held the full episode -- thesis stayed intact throughout. Early dips to -1 to -1.5pts (frames 0-6) never accelerated into a persistent breakdown; giveback spiked briefly to ~48% but price kept reclaiming breakeven. From frame 7 onward the trade trended favorably almost monotonically, running from +2.75 to a peak of +11.0/17.8pt amplitude with giveback repeatedly compressing back to single digits on new highs. Later pullbacks (frames 16-18, 26-33) were shallow retraces off a strong high, not directional reversals -- price stabilized well above breakeven each time and adverse fires (KMDR-against, HA-against) never persisted or coincided with accelerating loss. Nothing in the sequence showed the signature of a wrong-direction entry (sustained new lows below entry, compounding giveback, persistent multi-frame adverse momentum), so no EXIT was warranted. What I'd watch next time: an early giveback spike above ~40% combined with price failing to reclaim breakeven within a few frames would be the leading tell for a genuine wrong-direction entry, versus this trade's pattern of quick reclaim + eventual strong trend.
